ai_summary.text:
巴工業は遠心分離機の製造と化学品の商社機能を併せ持つ企業で、下水処理場向けデカンタ型遠心分離機と化学品の輸入販売を主力としている。汚泥の脱水処理に使用される遠心分離機で国内有力なシェアを持ち、機械製造と化学品商社の二本柱による安定した事業ポートフォリオを構築している。

売上594億円（前年比+13.9%）と堅調な増収を達成。営業利益54億円（営業利益率9%）と安定した利益率を実現し、純利益39億円。化学品の販売好調と下水処理設備の受注拡大が業績を牽引した。ROE9%と良好な資本効率を達成。

自己資本比率75.8%と高い水準にあり、財務健全性スコア83点と健全な財務基盤。営業CF24億円だがFCFマイナス1億円は設備投資が影響。EPS129円に対しPER12.3倍、配当109円で配当性向は約85%と極めて手厚い株主還元。下水処理施設の老朽化更新と化学品需要が安定した事業基盤を支えている。
ai_summary.text_en: Tomoe Engineering is a manufacturer of centrifuges with chemical commodity trading functions, with decantor centrifuges for wastewater treatment and imported chemical sales as core products. The company holds substantial domestic market share in centrifuges used for sludge dewatering, establishing a stable business portfolio built on dual pillars of machinery manufacturing and chemical trading. Sales reached 59.4 billion yen (up 13.9% YoY), achieving solid revenue growth. Operating profit of 5.4 billion yen (9% operating margin) realized stable profitability with net income of 3.9 billion yen. Strong chemical sales and expanded wastewater treatment equipment orders drove performance. ROE of 9% reflects favorable capital efficiency. With an equity ratio of 75.8% and financial health score of 83 points, the company maintains a sound foundation. Operating cash flow of 2.4 billion yen with negative free cash flow of 100 million yen reflects capital expenditure impact. Against EPS of 129 yen, PER of 12.3x, dividends of 109 yen represent an exceptionally generous payout ratio of approximately 85%. Aging wastewater treatment facility updates and stable chemical demand support the business foundation.
